description: Defines data structures and class for managing DU cells in a wireless communication system, including cell context, reconfiguration results, and management operations.

classes.name: du_cell_manager
classes.description: Manages DU cells, providing methods to add, remove, start, stop, and reconfigure cells.

methods.name: no_of_cells
methods.description: Returns the number of managed cells.

methods.name: has_cell
methods.description: Checks if a cell with the given index exists.

methods.name: is_cell_active
methods.description: Determines if a specific cell is active.

methods.name: get_cell_index
methods.description: Retrieves cell index based on different identifiers.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell with specified configuration.

methods.name: get_cell_cfg
methods.description: Gets the configuration of a specified cell.

methods.name: stop_accepting_ues
methods.description: Stops accepting new UEs in a specified cell.

methods.name: handle_cell_reconf_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for a cell.

methods.name: get_sys_info
methods.description: Retrieves system information configuration for a cell.
